title: Reading Practice Test 05 – Recruitment & Human Resources
description: Đề luyện Reading theo cấu trúc đề thi TOEIC (IIG Việt Nam), rút gọn 28 câu: Part 5 (10) · Part 6 (4, có câu điền cả câu) · Part 7 (14: tin nhắn, bản ghi nhớ, thư mời nhận việc có chèn câu, đoạn kép). Chủ đề: tuyển dụng, phúc lợi, chính sách nhân sự.

questions.content: Applicants must submit a résumé and two letters of ------- by May 15.
questions.explanation: 'letters of recommendation' = thư giới thiệu. Sau giới từ 'of' cần danh từ.

questions.content: The human resources department is ------- for organizing the new employee orientation.
questions.explanation: Cấu trúc 'be responsible for' = chịu trách nhiệm về. 'responsive' = phản hồi nhanh – sai nghĩa.

questions.content: Ms. Fischer has ------- experience in project management, having led teams in three countries.
questions.explanation: Tính từ bổ nghĩa cho danh từ 'experience' → 'extensive experience' (kinh nghiệm dày dặn).

questions.content: Candidates ------- for the second round of interviews will be notified by e-mail.
questions.explanation: Mệnh đề quan hệ rút gọn bị động: Candidates (who are) selected for… → 'selected'.

questions.content: The company offers flexible working hours ------- employees can balance work and family life.
questions.explanation: Chỉ mục đích (để nhân viên có thể cân bằng…) → 'so that' + mệnh đề.

questions.content: Mr. Owens will retire at the end of the year after ------- the company for 25 years.
questions.explanation: Sau giới từ 'after' dùng V-ing → 'serving'.

questions.content: Neither the manager ------- her assistant was available to answer questions about the position.
questions.explanation: Cặp liên từ 'neither … nor' = không … cũng không.

questions.content: All new hires are required to complete a ------- period of three months.
questions.explanation: Tính từ đứng trước danh từ 'period': 'probationary period' = thời gian thử việc.

questions.content: The interview panel was impressed by how ------- the candidate answered the technical questions.
questions.explanation: Bổ nghĩa cho động từ 'answered' → trạng từ 'confidently' (how + adv + S + V).

questions.content: Employees may take up to ten days of paid leave ------- the calendar year.
questions.explanation: 'during + khoảng thời gian' = trong suốt. 'among/between' dùng cho người/vật.

groups.passage:
Join Our Team at Greenway Logistics!

Greenway Logistics, a fast-growing shipping company based in Denver, is ---131--- an experienced warehouse supervisor. The successful candidate will oversee a team of 20 workers and ensure that all orders are processed accurately.

Applicants should have at least three years of supervisory experience. ---132---, knowledge of inventory management software is strongly preferred.

We offer a competitive salary, health insurance, and ---133--- paid vacation. ---134---.

To apply, send your résumé and cover letter to careers@greenwaylogistics.com by June 30.

questions.explanation: Sau 'is' dùng V-ing (hiện tại tiếp diễn): công ty đang tìm → 'seeking'.
Câu sau bổ sung thêm một yêu cầu (biết phần mềm quản lý kho) → 'In addition'.
Tính từ bổ nghĩa cho cụm danh từ 'paid vacation' → 'generous' (hào phóng, nhiều ngày).

options.B: Please call us if you lose a package.
options.C: Our trucks are cleaned every week.
options.D: Employees are also eligible for annual performance bonuses.

questions.explanation: Câu trước liệt kê phúc lợi → câu chèn nối tiếp với một phúc lợi khác (thưởng hiệu suất).

groups.passage:
Text message – Lakeside Medical Center

Hi Ms. Duarte, this is Paul from Lakeside Medical Center. Thank you for applying for the receptionist position. We'd like to invite you for an interview on Thursday, May 9, at 10:30 A.M. Please bring a copy of your nursing assistant certificate. Reply YES to confirm, or call me to choose another time.

questions.content: Why was the message sent?

options.A: To offer Ms. Duarte a job
options.B: To remind her of a doctor's appointment

questions.explanation: 'We'd like to invite you for an interview on Thursday, May 9.'

questions.content: What is Ms. Duarte asked to bring?
questions.explanation: 'Please bring a copy of your nursing assistant certificate.'

groups.passage:
MEMO
To: All Employees
From: Rachel Kim, Human Resources Director
Date: February 3
Re: Employee Referral Program

We are pleased to announce a new employee referral program. If you recommend a candidate who is hired for a full-time position, you will receive a bonus of $1,000. The bonus will be paid after the new employee has worked with us for three months.

Referrals can be submitted through the Careers section of the company intranet. Please include the candidate's résumé and a short explanation of why you think he or she would be a good fit.

Note that managers are not eligible for bonuses when they refer candidates to their own departments. For more details, please see the attached guidelines.

questions.content: What is the purpose of the memo?

options.C: To explain a change in salaries

questions.explanation: 'We are pleased to announce a new employee referral program.'

questions.content: When will the bonus be paid?

options.A: Immediately after a candidate is hired
options.B: After the new employee has worked for three months
options.C: At the end of the year

questions.explanation: 'The bonus will be paid after the new employee has worked with us for three months.'

questions.content: What is indicated about managers?

options.C: They must attend an information session.
options.D: They face a restriction on receiving the bonus.

questions.explanation: Quản lý không được thưởng khi giới thiệu ứng viên vào chính phòng ban của mình → có giới hạn.

groups.passage:
Dear Mr. Castillo,

On behalf of Northwind Engineering, I am delighted to offer you the position of Senior Mechanical Engineer at our Houston office. [1] Your experience designing energy-efficient systems impressed everyone on the hiring committee.

As discussed during your final interview, your starting salary will be $92,000 per year. You will also be eligible for our health and retirement plans after 30 days of employment. [2] Your first day will be Monday, September 8, and you will report to Dr. Helen Park, Director of Engineering.

Please sign and return the enclosed contract by August 22. [3] If you have any questions about the terms, feel free to contact me directly.

We look forward to welcoming you to the team. [4]

Sincerely,
Monica Reyes
Human Resources Manager

questions.content: What is the main purpose of the letter?
questions.explanation: 'I am delighted to offer you the position of Senior Mechanical Engineer.'

questions.content: What is stated about the benefits?

options.C: They begin after a waiting period.
options.D: They must be requested in writing.

questions.explanation: '…eligible for our health and retirement plans after 30 days of employment' → sau một khoảng chờ.

questions.content: Who most likely is Dr. Helen Park?
questions.explanation: 'You will report to Dr. Helen Park, Director of Engineering' – report to = làm việc dưới quyền → cấp trên trực tiếp.

questions.content:
In which of the positions marked [1], [2], [3], and [4] does the following sentence best belong?
"In addition, you will receive 15 days of paid vacation per year."
questions.explanation: Câu chèn bổ sung thêm phúc lợi (nghỉ phép có lương), nối tiếp câu về lương và bảo hiểm → vị trí [2].

groups.passage:
Now Hiring: Bilingual Customer Support Specialist
Atlas Travel Group – Miami, Florida (hybrid: three days in the office, two days remote)

Responsibilities:
• Assist customers by phone and e-mail with bookings and changes
• Resolve complaints in a professional and timely manner
• Prepare weekly reports on common customer issues

Requirements:
• Fluency in English and Spanish
• At least two years of customer service experience
• Ability to work some weekends during peak travel seasons

Applications will be reviewed beginning March 1. All interviews will be conducted by video.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

To: jobs@atlastravel.com
From: Sofia Mendes
Date: February 25
Subject: Application – Bilingual Customer Support Specialist

Dear Hiring Manager,

I am writing to apply for the Bilingual Customer Support Specialist position. I am fluent in English, Spanish, and Portuguese, and I have spent the last four years working in the call center of an international airline, where I was named Employee of the Year in 2023.

I am currently living in Orlando but am planning to move to Miami in April, so the position's schedule would suit me well. I should mention that I am available to work weekends only twice a month, as I am completing a part-time degree in hospitality management.

My résumé is attached. Thank you for your consideration.

Sincerely,
Sofia Mendes

questions.content: What is NOT listed as a responsibility of the position?
questions.explanation: Câu hỏi NOT: tin tuyển dụng không nhắc tới việc đào tạo nhân viên mới.

questions.content: What is indicated about the interviews?

options.B: They will take place in Orlando.

questions.explanation: 'All interviews will be conducted by video' → phỏng vấn trực tuyến.

questions.content: What is suggested about Ms. Mendes?

options.C: She has managed a call center.
options.D: She previously worked for Atlas Travel Group.

questions.explanation: Công việc yêu cầu thông thạo tiếng Anh và tiếng Tây Ban Nha; cô nói được cả hai (và thêm tiếng Bồ Đào Nha) → đáp ứng yêu cầu ngôn ngữ.

questions.content: Why does Ms. Mendes mention a degree?

options.A: To show that she has management experience
options.C: To explain why she is moving
options.D: To explain a limit on when she can work

questions.explanation: Cô chỉ làm được hai cuối tuần mỗi tháng vì đang học bằng bán thời gian → giải thích giới hạn thời gian làm việc.

questions.content: When will Ms. Mendes most likely be able to work in the Miami office?
questions.explanation: Công việc làm 3 ngày tại văn phòng Miami; cô đang sống ở Orlando và sẽ chuyển tới Miami vào tháng Tư.
